'''Berix''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was a member of the [[Deadeyes]], a [[Republic Army]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. When the Deadeyes allowed themselves to be captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]], he and some of his fellow Deadeyes were sent to a labor camp in [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Havoc Squad]] eventually rescued him.
